subject: AegleThera: one-time onboarding rebate — request for VP/CFO approval
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: AegleThera onboarding rebate request — needing VP/CFO approval

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick summary for context: AegleThera (prospect -> pilot -> likely enterprise) is asking for a one-time onboarding rebate and additional free seat credits to accelerate go-live. They committed to a 12–18 month initial ramp and indicated a willingness to move to a dedicated plan if early SLAs are met. Key numbers:

- Proposed list ARR: $1,180,000 annualized on a 12-month ramp
- Customer request: 35% one-time rebate on first-year invoice + 1500 free seats (usage credits) applied over 6 months
- Requested term length: 18 months with a 12-month minimum commitment

Why they asked: procurement insists on budget smoothing for year 1 and argues the credit will offset initial integration costs. They signaled competitor interest if we can’t concede some commercial flexibility.

Impact (finance view requested):
- P&L: ~ $413k reduction in recognized revenue year 1 (assuming full rebate applied)
- Likely upside: faster ramp, additional expansion potential in Q3–Q4 across three regions

Attachments: aegle_statement_of_work_v1.pdf (SOW), aegle_revenue_impact_v2.xlsx (simple model), proposed_mop_terms.txt (legal/ops notes).

Ask: I need an internal approval memo we can attach to the commercial offer that has VP (Marissa) and CFO (Markus) sign-off or an explicit conditional approval path. If full rebate isn’t acceptable, I propose this alternative structure for signoff:

- 25% capped rebate applied against first 6 months invoice + 750 usage credits over 3 months
- Revenue make-good clause if renewal < 80% of forecast at month 12

Can you review and advise whether we can escalate this for Markus’ signature? I’ve included the HubSpot deal link in the metadata and flagged this as time-sensitive for the customer’s procurement window (responses due by 2027-06-15).

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AegleThera onboarding rebate request — needing VP/CFO approval

Aditya —

Thanks for the concise packet. I don’t love the 35% headline but I understand the procurement pressure. Short comments and recommended route:

1) Offer the alternative you proposed (25% capped rebate + 750 credits) as the commercial baseline — this preserves margin while giving the customer smoothing.
2) Add a time-bound adoption milestone: 50% of credits vest only if integration milestones 1 & 2 are met within 90 days.
3) Include a step-down clause that reduces the rebate proportional to realized ARR at month 12 (protects revenue).

I’m looping in Markus for CFO signoff. If Markus can green-light conditional approval (25% + vesting + make-good), we can present this to Aegle with an exec intro from me and close next week.

Please prep a one-page exec memo (bulletized) that calls out net revenue impact, mitigation clauses, and recommended fallback (no rebate, additional onboarding support credits instead). Keep it tight — Markus is on a short timeline today.

—Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: AegleThera onboarding rebate request — exec memo attached (for CFO review)

Markus — forwarding the packet and Marissa’s recommended route. Attaching the one-page memo (below) and the revenue model. Key ask is a conditional CFO signoff for the 25% capped rebate + vesting schedule.

---Forwarded exec memo (bulletized)---
Purpose: Request one-time commercial variance for AegleThera to secure a 12–18 month committed ramp and displace competitor.

Net impact (year 1): Estimated recognized revenue reduction of up to $295k under the 25% capped rebate structure; downside mitigated by vesting and make-good.
Risk mitigations:
- Vesting tied to technical milestones 1 & 2 (prod ingest + initial inference throughput)
- Make-good clause if renewal < 80% of forecast at month 12 (clawback or credit reversal)
- Cap rebate dollar amount to limit one-off exposure

Alternative if not approved: Offer onboarding professional services credits and extended trial usage (no direct revenue rebate).

Timing: Customer needs response by 2027-06-15 to keep procurement cadence.

Attachments: aegle_statement_of_work_v1.pdf, aegle_revenue_impact_v2.xlsx, proposed_mop_terms.txt

Can you advise if you’ll sign off or if you prefer finance drafting a short approval memo with conditional language?

Thanks — Aditya
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 23:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: AegleThera onboarding rebate request — exec memo attached (for CFO review)

Aditya / Marissa —

I reviewed the memo and the attached model. I’m comfortable with the conditional structure you outlined with the following explicit requirements before I sign:

1) Cap: maximum rebate exposure capped at $300k, written into the commercial offer.
2) Vesting: 50% of the usage credits vest on successful completion of Milestone 1 (data ingest + baseline throughput test); remaining 50% after Milestone 2 (production traffic > 10k tokens/min sustained for 7 days).
3) Clawback: if renewal ARR < 80% of the committed forecast at month 12, we reserve the right to recoup rebate value via credit reversal or invoice adjustment in year 2.
4) Contractual routing: Legal to include a short addendum that enumerates the cap, vesting milestones, and clawback mechanism. Ops to confirm we can measure the metrics reliably.

If legal & ops confirm the language is implementable and the $300k cap is present in the final SOW, I will sign the internal approval memo and authorize the commercial team to present the revised offer. Please loop in Legal (cc me on the SOW addendum) and Finance for a short approval note (this email thread can be referenced).

Markus Klein
CFO, Redwood Inference
